Missing `kof.ui` `Scroll` layout widget (architecture §2.8 promises it). Subject (the UI widget set) is outside the 1.0 core surface; the UI lane owns the additive widget. Not a 1.0 blocker.

Real cross-backend CORRECTNESS defect on supported targets: on Native riscv64/aarch64 (qemu), a call with 9+ total arguments (records with 8+ fields, methods with 8+ params) silently computes WRONG values — no crash, no diagnostic; JVM/JS/x86-64 are correct (golden). Violates the cross-target parity contract (rule 5) and the D-RELEASE-1.0 exit gate; catalogued as `known-bugs` §546 (distinct from §545 = spawn×extern SIGSEGV). Core semantics, must be closed before the first RC.

Design front `D-SIZE-BUDGET` (Phase 1 = measurement only): a size/observability contract for the KOF distribution; no behaviour or dependency changes, no CI blocking. Not part of the 1.0 core surface; accepted after 1.0 (rule-6 decision request tracked separately).
